The actual support satisfies h_K(u)=1+s max_i〈vi,P_Uu〉≤1+sp, with equality precisely for projected normals pvi. The proposed ellipsoid with squared radii A=(1+st)(1+s/t), B=1+st has support gap A p²+B(1−p²)−(1+sp)²=(s/t)(p−t)²≥0; it contains K in all directions. Equality normals p=t and projected vi yield exactly (s+t)vi+sqrt(1−t²)w as contacts. The normalized contact squared U and U⊥ portions are k/n and (n−k)/n. Taking each vi with signed unit basis in U⊥ yields finite equal-weight isotropic normalized mean 0, covariance I_n/n. Any encompassing ellipsoid then obeys a trace inverse-square constraint and AM-GM forcing determinant ≥1 with equality only at identity, certifying global Löwner optimality without symmetry assumptions. Differentiating log κ_n A^{k/2}B^{(n−k)/2} along parameter t(s), stationary derivative eliminates t′ and gives k/(s+t) and negative second derivative, with s=0 and s→∞ correct limits.
